title: Pay Buddy
tagline: A universal payment router to recieve your preffered tokens in your preffered destination (network/bank)
description:
Its solves the pain point of managing different chains and crypto tokens to recieve payments. It also reduces volatility risk involved in recieving payments.

**Links**
- [https://app.safe.global/transactions/history?safe=sep:0x966f7DA837BA5F1E573018F2897c9F02204aBaa5](https://app.safe.global/transactions/history?safe=sep:0x966f7DA837BA5F1E573018F2897c9F02204aBaa5)
how_its_made:
I have built the project and a working demo using Safe AA kit + pimlico. I have faced a lot of issues trying to integrate them since they are by default not compatible. 

I have able to go through the entire library of safe and pimlico to create custom modules which bridge the two libraries.
